At native receiving source `d7abb46`, canonical nm coordinates and actual MolSysMT vdW radii define two additional exact Models. Radius bits differ from the older supplied-radius Models, so original inputs/results are preserved. Old partitions are untrusted candidates until full independent target checking reconstructs every inequality, cell and radial predicate; each comparison then matches the actual target input exactly.

All three narrow wet-carrier unions (28/7/1 tetrahedra) and the wide union (one tetrahedron) are completely excluded. The exact point query classifies 22 narrow centers blocked inside the hull, eight outside it and the wide center outside; domain-first status does not assert absence of atomic collision. Full carrier exclusion is independent of the stored center and includes the connector-only bank.

Both workers complete sequentially in 146.660 wall / 146.473 CPU seconds, peak RSS 308760 KiB, one CPU and 2 GiB. Matching failures, exact round-trip/radius diagnostics and the invalid boundary-tolerance attempt remain recorded. Guards protect real input bits, target proofs, source supports and retained public objects.

The **physical qualification/public reporting decision remains open**, lifecycle `needs_review`. Local operators, bank admission and promotion are unchanged. Wider canonical receiver/support work stays #76/#60; no general solver defect or paper limitation is established.
